column1: # Per-file CEILING for baseline E (#9597 S1), path<TAB>sites, in the baseline's own order
# (LC_ALL=C sort). It is currently IDENTICAL to scripts/lint-shell-trace-credential-refusal-e.baseline.txt
# (seeded from the same census), so it is NOT an independent review of the baseline. What it
# pins, and nothing more: a second file that must be edited in step, so growing baseline E (a new
# offender row, or a count raised above its row here) cannot be done by `--write-baseline-e`
# alone -- the suite fails until this table is edited too, which a reviewer then sees in the diff.
# It is checked in BOTH directions: every baseline row needs a row here at or above its count,
# and every row here needs a baseline row OR a file that still offends. A converted file must
# therefore leave this table in the same change that removes it from the baseline.
